reference_opening.argument: This video is non-scam content because it is framed as a beginner-friendly lesson explaining cryptocurrency, digital decentralization, and blockchain concepts through narration and educational graphics. Although it includes a channel-subscription prompt and Coinbase-related resource links, it states that the material is informational and not a recommendation to buy, sell, or hold a financial product. The described visuals reinforce the explanatory focus, and no promised return, required payment, credential request, or other concrete deceptive mechanism is shown.

citations.quote: In this beginner-friendly video, we'll demystify the fundamentals of cryptocurrency.
Cryptocurrencies are a digital form of money.
a blockchain is like a shared record book that keeps track of every single transaction that takes place
cryptocurrencies are decentralized

opening.argument: The presentation does more than describe cryptocurrency: it gives viewers a direct participation pathway. After discussing digital money and Bitcoin, the description tells viewers, “To own a piece of the future visit Coinbase: https://coinbase.com.” That links the aspirational future framing to visiting a named crypto platform. Even without a stated return, directing viewers toward acquiring cryptocurrency can function as a purchase solicitation, making the closest concern token acquisition promoted through an educational wrapper.

citations.quote: To own a piece of the future visit Coinbase: https://coinbase.com
Cryptocurrencies are a digital form of money.
What is Cryptocurrency - Coinbase Crypto University

rebuttal.rebuttal: Calling the material beginner-friendly does not answer the concrete call to visit Coinbase and “own a piece of the future.” The informational framing may explain the subject, but it does not eliminate the commercial implication of directing viewers to a crypto platform. The disclaimer also does not change what the invitation asks viewers to do.

citations.quote: In this beginner-friendly video, we'll demystify the fundamentals of cryptocurrency.
To own a piece of the future visit Coinbase: https://coinbase.com

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The invitation does not say viewers should buy, invest, deposit, or expect appreciation; it merely directs interested viewers to Coinbase. The video’s actual narration explains cryptocurrency as a concept and blockchain as a record system, while the description expressly disclaims investment advice. Those facts leave a commercial association, but they do not establish a token-purchase scam.

citations.quote: Nothing discussed in this video is intended to be investment advice.
recommendation by Coinbase to buy, sell or hold any security, financial product or instrument referenced in the content.
a blockchain is like a shared record book that keeps track of every single transaction that takes place

opening.argument: Several signals can reasonably make the crypto promotion look riskier than neutral education: the description says cryptocurrency’s popularity has surged, presents it as “the future,” supplies a direct Coinbase URL, and includes multiple follow and subscription links. In combination, those signals encourage attention and platform engagement around a financial asset. The material does not provide a return figure, but the repeated promotional pathway means token acquisition concerns are not fully ruled out.

citations.quote: Cryptocurrency's popularity has surged in recent years
To own a piece of the future visit Coinbase: https://coinbase.com
Subscribe to our channel here:
Follow us on Twitter: https://twitter.com/coinbase

rebuttal.rebuttal: The defense treats the absence of an explicit return promise as dispositive, but scam-like promotion can also rely on aspirational language and easy access to a financial platform. “Own a piece of the future” is not merely a technical definition; paired with the external Coinbase link, it gives the promotional framing practical direction. The disclaimer is relevant, but it does not erase those visible risk signals.

citations.quote: To own a piece of the future visit Coinbase: https://coinbase.com
Cryptocurrency's popularity has surged in recent years

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The cited signals show branding and audience engagement, not deception. “Popularity has surged” is a general contextual statement, and the future phrase is not tied to any promised profit, appreciation, or guaranteed outcome. The supplied description specifically says the content is informational and rejects recommendations to buy, sell, or hold a financial product, so the risk inference remains speculative.

citations.quote: This content is being provided to you for informational purposes only.
recommendation by Coinbase to buy, sell or hold any security, financial product or instrument referenced in the content.
To own a piece of the future visit Coinbase: https://coinbase.com

opening.argument: The educational role can also be read as customer acquisition for Coinbase. The title identifies “Coinbase Crypto University,” the description repeatedly identifies Coinbase and directs viewers to its site, learning resources, and social accounts, while the narration makes cryptocurrency accessible by calling it a form of money. That combination lowers the barrier to understanding and then channels interested viewers toward the company’s crypto ecosystem. The lesson may be accurate, but its practical function can still be promotional participation in token markets.

citations.quote: What is Cryptocurrency - Coinbase Crypto University
At Coinbase, our mission is to create an open financial system for the world.
To own a piece of the future visit Coinbase: https://coinbase.com
Learn more about cryptocurrency here: https://www.coinbase.com/learn
Cryptocurrencies are a digital form of money.

rebuttal.rebuttal: The defense focuses on the narration’s accuracy while overlooking who presents the lesson and where viewers are sent afterward. A company-branded “University” can educate while also building trust in its own platform. The direct invitation to visit Coinbase and the stated mission to create an open financial system support reading the lesson as promotion, not purely detached instruction.

citations.quote: What is Cryptocurrency - Coinbase Crypto University
At Coinbase, our mission is to create an open financial system for the world.
To own a piece of the future visit Coinbase: https://coinbase.com

true_side_reply.rebuttal: Brand involvement and links establish sponsorship or promotion, but they do not establish a scam category. The content explains digital money, decentralization, and blockchain rather than promising token appreciation or dividends. Most importantly, the description expressly limits the material to information and says it is not a recommendation to buy, sell, or hold a financial product.
